svg.title: The Ranger's Book: the first page, before Tam reads it
svg.desc: The same front page as Marisol turns to it, before Tam has marked anything: the pencil Sites page under the later ink columns, the party of five with no check-out, the first ink row. No pencil ring, no note beside the ink, and Tam's notebook lies open on the facing page with its lines still empty.
svg.text: the split boulder, slept in the crack
